objective: Mine Quantum Foundations/Information/Open Systems results that map cleanly onto VDM’s J/M split (A4) with locality (A2) and entropy production (A5), prioritizing CPTP/Lindblad structures with microscopic locality.
scope: Quantum information & thermodynamics metrics and entropy production (RM-06)
Open quantum systems with locality-preserving baths and microscopic GKSL derivations (RM-07)
inputs_today: Public web/papers only (peer‑reviewed, authoritative reviews, textbooks).

queries: metriplectic quantum; Lindblad double commutator; Madelung hydrodynamics entropy
Spohn inequality Lindblad entropy production; Petz monotone metrics; gradient flow Lindblad
local GKSL microscopic derivation; collision models; weak coupling Davies; universal Lindblad

decision_rules.RM-03: Strong if CP-divisible/Lindblad form + local coupling.
decision_rules.RM-06: Strong if Σ̇ ≥ 0 is stated/derived with a named norm/metric for a Lindblad/CPTP evolution.
decision_rules.RM-07: Strong if a microscopic model (weak-coupling/collision) → GKSL with explicitly local couplings.

red_flags: Non-CP evolutions used as physical dynamics (vs. effective fits).
Unstated bath assumptions that violate local coupling.
Ambiguous entropy functionals unrelated to a CPTP/Lindblad generator.

rows.generator_type: Lindblad (pure dephasing with Hermitian jump A): 𝓛[ρ] = γ(AρA − ½{A²,ρ}) = −(γ/2)[A,[A,ρ]]
rows.locality: Local when A is local (e.g., σz on a qubit/site).
rows.Impression: Canonical M-limb (metric) appears as double‑commutator dissipation; J-limb is −i[H,ρ]. With local A, this obeys VDM locality and entropy monotonicity.

rows.generator_type: Lindblad with detailed balance (Davies/BKM): gradient‑flow structure
rows.sigma_meaning: Umegaki relative entropy S(ρ‖σ) to stationary σ
rows.locality: Local if jump operators couple locally to baths
rows.Impression: When BKM detailed balance holds, the M‑limb is a gradient flow of S(ρ‖σ). This is a direct J/M realization matching VDM.

rows.sigma_meaning: Generalized entropy/free‑energy functional Σ with M≥0
rows.Impression: Provides an abstract J/M template consistent with VDM; exact operator‑algebraic quantum metriplectic parallel is not yet fully established.

rows.sigma_meaning: Shannon/Fisher‑linked entropies for density; not an M‑limb dissipator
rows.Impression: Captures J‑limb structure and information‑geometry links; requires explicit Lindblad addition for VDM-consistent M‑limb in open settings.

rows.generator: GKSL (quantum dynamical semigroup) with stationary ρ_ss
rows.how_to_gate: Engineer σ− (amplitude damping) or σz (dephasing) jumps via optical pumping or flux/drive‑noise; verify Σ̇≥0 by tomography or process tomography.
rows.Impression: Direct M‑limb realization with rigorous entropy production; ideal for dissipative state prep and stabilization.

rows.generator: CPTP/Lindblad with BKM detailed balance (gradient‑flow form)
rows.how_to_gate: Satisfy detailed balance by tailoring jump spectra to bath temperature; implement local amplitude damping/dephasing on hardware; calibrate using Petz/Bures distances as fit losses.
rows.Impression: Maps M‑limb to contractive metrics; suggests metric‑aware dissipative compiling and gate‑level reservoir engineering.

rows.generator: General CPTP channels (discrete or continuous time)
rows.contractivity_metric: D(ρ‖σ) monotone; also sandwiched Rényi divergences
rows.how_to_gate: Compose gates + noise channels (Kraus) to implement CPTP maps; validate via DPI checks on tomography datasets.
rows.Impression: Confirms Σ‑style contractivity beyond strict Lindblad; still aligns with VDM M‑limb as metric gradient‑like flow.

rows.generator: Lindblad (gradient‑flow characterization necessary & sufficient under BKM detailed balance)
rows.how_to_gate: Design jump operators that are BKM‑self‑adjoint w.r.t. σ; in practice, thermalizing local jump sets respecting detailed balance.
rows.Impression: Gives a crisp condition for when Lindblad is exactly an M‑limb gradient flow, guiding experiment design.
Textbook route to local GKSL; robust template for VDM‑compatible open dynamics.

rows.markov_non_markov: Markov (memoryless ancillas); Non‑Markov with correlated ancillas
rows.microscopic_derivation: Stroboscopic collisions → GKSL in continuous‑time limit
rows.Impression: Constructive, locality‑preserving path to GKSL; clean experimental knob for M‑limb strength.

rows.bath_model: Universal Lindblad equation (properties depend only on bath and couplings)
rows.microscopic_derivation: Derived master equation guaranteeing CP with minimal assumptions
rows.Impression: Broad GKSL form with explicit dependence on system–bath coupling structure; aligns with VDM local causality.

rows.bath_model: Weakly damped systems (accurate Lindblad across regimes)
rows.microscopic_derivation: Derivation ensuring positivity beyond traditional approximations
rows.Impression: Improves GKSL accuracy for realistic devices; preserves VDM M‑limb thermodynamic consistency.

rows.bath_model: Quadratic fermion/boson models with independent thermal baths
rows.microscopic_derivation: Self‑consistent microscopic derivation → Lindblad with normal‑mode jump operators
rows.Impression: Constructive microscopic path to local GKSL with unique steady state; practical for many‑body testbeds.

rows.bath_model: Local master equations bypassing strict secular approximation
rows.microscopic_derivation: From Redfield with locality preserved; accuracy window characterized
rows.Impression: Useful local GKSL‑like dynamics when full global derivation is impractical; check CP/accuracy regime.
